name: All gatherers complete → researcher-research-synthesize (join)
description: ADR-046 Phase 1 JOIN — synthesize half. Fires on the PLAN loop entity (where rule 03a accumulates research.gather.completed_subtopic triples) when the counter length matches the planner's coordinator.decision.subtopics list length. Uses beta.84 #149 .length substitution so the join is dynamic — N=1 prompts (single subtopic, single gatherer) and N=many prompts both work without per-width forking. cooldown=5s guards against double-fire if two gatherers stamp within the same evaluation window. The spawned synthesizer receives plan_loop_id in its properties AND the JSON-encoded list of gather loop ids inlined into its prompt via beta.86's $entity.triple.<predicate>.triples substitution (ADR-048 PR 4 / #155, closes semstreams#151) — no graph-query tool needed, persona prose teaches the JSON-parse-the-array pattern.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-synthesize
on_enter.prompt:
SYNTHESIZE phase entry — aggregating fan-out. The PLAN loop at $entity.instance fanned out N gatherers via for_each over its subtopics list; all N have stamped completion and you are spawned to aggregate.

Inputs:
- plan_loop_id (in your task properties): $entity.instance — call read_loop_result on it to read the plan (goal, context, scope, full subtopics list)
- Sibling gather loop IDs (inlined here as a JSON array via ADR-048 .triples substitution): $entity.triple.research.gather.completed_subtopic.triples — parse this as JSON, then iterate each loop ID and call read_loop_result on each to fetch that gatherer's findings

Each gatherer's decide.reason opens with 'Subtopic: <verbatim>' so you can index contributions against the plan's subtopics list. Compose ONE aggregated research artifact (actors deduplicated across subtopics, integration_points spanning boundaries, tasks decomposed against the plan, open_gaps carried forward from any sibling that surfaced one) per researcher-research-synthesize/00-identity.md, 10-output-contract.md, and 30-emit-artifact.md. Use scratchpad to decompose the aggregation before the strict-schema emit_research_artifact call.

This pack terminates at reviewer-research after emit. Architect / spec / build phases do not exist in the research category.

Terminal: decide(action="emit") forwards to reviewer-research; decide(action="needs_clarification") when the aggregate evidence is structurally inconsistent with the plan.

metadata.triples_substitution_requires: semstreams beta.86 (#155 / ADR-048 PR 4) — $entity.triple.*.triples substitution (closes #151). Sibling loop IDs render as a JSON-encoded array string inlined into the prompt.
metadata.fires_on_plan_entity: Subscribes to the planner's loop entity (NOT the gather entities). Rule 03a stamps gather.completed_subtopic ON the plan entity (via subject override); when the Nth stamp matches the subtopics length, this rule's condition flips true and fires once. cooldown=5s is defense-in-depth against same-tick double-evaluation.
